t: A cloud coding environment that students open in a browser with no local setup.
steps: Find GitHub Education and apply to get verified as a teacher.
Create a GitHub Classroom for your course.
Enable Codespaces through GitHub Classroom and not in the organization settings.
Select Codespaces as the editor for one assignment.
Check the usage limits so the organization is not billed by surprise.
Turn off VS Code telemetry in the codespace settings.
Have students sign in and open the assignment.
